_comment: Registry backends for TLDs the IANA RDAP bootstrap does not cover (or covers badly).
rdap: base URL (base + 'domain/<fqdn>'); null with status rdap means 'use the IANA bootstrap'.
whois: port-43 server; with status rdap it is only a fallback if RDAP resolution yields nothing.
Only entries verified live (a registered name vs a random one) may be rdap/whois: a wrong
reason: user-facing explanation, required for restricted/unavailable.

rdap_denylist.reason: When verified (2026-10-06), the RDAP replies for these TLDs did not distinguish registered from unregistered names, so they are checked over WHOIS instead.
